other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: General statement about plants that run continuously and the risk of stopping a continuous production line, used as generic hypothesis rationale rather than tied to a specific continuous-flow sector
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Implementing energy efﬁciency projects implies stopping a
plant that may run continuously except for periodic maintenance
shutdowns, which is problematic in most cases. The rationale for
this is that stopping a continuous production line entails sub-
stantial technical risks

one_line: A survey-based study applying Motivation-Opportunity-Ability theory to explain energy efficiency barriers across a broad mix of Singapore manufacturing firms (machinery, chemicals, metals, electronics, food & beverage), not focused on any specific continuous-flow production process.
